public_observation: PEMA public fact-sheet table lists full-EPZ ETE values and says the KLD report for ETEs had not been released; table to be updated once released
conflict_or_risk: public numbers may be treated as final KLD route proof even though the public table itself marks the KLD report unreleased
required_resolution: load actual current KLD/ETE artifact or authorized extract, hash it, inventory scenarios, and reconcile every public-table value

public_observation: Ohio 2025 REP plan references Beaver Valley Nuclear Power Station Development of Evacuation Time Estimates; KLD Engineering, P.C.; August 29, 2022
conflict_or_risk: a reference to an artifact is not the artifact; it does not prove scenario values, assumptions, route controls, or update status
required_resolution: obtain named August 29 2022 KLD/ETE packet or authorized redacted extract with checksum and owner

public_observation: Columbiana County RERP Rev.38 uses KLD Engineering 2022 ETE for route capacities, school evacuation, and medical-facility movement tables
conflict_or_risk: public plan tables can define load and assumptions but cannot prove current exercise performance or WV/PA parity
required_resolution: reconcile county tables to KLD scenario inventory and exercise route/special-facility performance results

public_observation: NRC ADAMS search/index exposes historical KLD TR-495 Rev.2 public PDFs from the 2012/2013 source clock
conflict_or_risk: stale historical KLD material can be accidentally substituted for the referenced 2022 KLD packet
required_resolution: label old ADAMS KLD artifacts historical-only and require date/revision match before use

public_observation: Appendix E requires population change estimates between decennial censuses and updated ETE analysis when threshold increases occur
conflict_or_risk: a 2022 KLD date is not enough if population/vehicle demand changed or thresholds triggered update duties
required_resolution: load annual population/vehicle-demand review and any 50.54(q)/ETE update screening result

public_observation: KLD general page describes NPP ETE study purpose and update cadence conceptually
conflict_or_risk: general vendor method page cannot establish Beaver Valley route capacities or current assumptions
required_resolution: do not use general vendor content for site closure; use only site-specific current KLD packet

public_observation: NRC RIS 2001-016 gives context that updating ETEs can be handled under emergency-plan change processes when effectiveness is not decreased
conflict_or_risk: change-process permissibility can be mistaken for exercised offsite performance
required_resolution: pair any updated ETE with emergency-plan impact screen, offsite distribution, and exercise/CAP evidence
